_doc: DEFENSE UNITS — the canonical source of truth for 'what to run'. A UNIT is a (leakage-defense × gem5-implementation) pair: e.g. the STT leakage contract run on the STT build, OR on the SPT implementation's STT-like sub-implementation. Each unit bundles a latest Alloy MODEL + three reusable criteria JSONs — leakage (specs/leakage/), timing (specs/timing/), fanout (specs/fanout/) — a build, a status, and an ordering number. The dashboard draws ONE outlined box per unit around its whole XML→GEM5 row (numbered, status in the corner, yellow=in-progress / green=done), and a TO-RUN section at top for paper-discussed units with no results here yet. status ∈ done | in_progress | to_run. criteria values are filenames in the specs/<kind>/ candidate folders (or 'NEEDS: ...' when one must be created).
_status: SCAFFOLD — numbers/statuses are a first pass from the paper + results/ scan; confirm with Anna.
_eval: Eval set approved by Anna 2026-11-08 (every STT implementation run separately). Each unit's eval object = row in wiki/state/EVAL_MANIFEST.md: set (core/optional), gem5_flags (beyond harness defaults), testset, run_config, checker, status, blocker. Paths testsets_latest/ runconfigs/fixed_20261030/ results/ are in /tests/simspect_fixed_20261030 on cafe2.

model_families._doc: One family per main model (added 2026-11-08, stl-spec). main = branch speculation (the unit's alloy_model); stl = the same defense with store-to-load speculation (an older store whose address is unresolved; derived by STAGE1_alloy/models/proposed/derive_stl.py); core / stl_core = the split (two-phase) Stage-1 core of each (wiki/design/TWO_PHASE_MODELS.md). Paths are under STAGE1_alloy/models/. Human view: wiki/state/EVAL_MANIFEST.md (moved from STAGE1_alloy/models/MANIFEST.md 2026-11-08). Stage-1 minimality: RI-only for every family except SPT (Anna 2026-11-08); Stage 1.5 not built for any family; Alloy runs move to the cafe2 gem5_dev container.
